name: alfacode-team/ground
description: The plugin developer's test bench — boot one plugin on a real kernel, with no project, no database and no configuration.

extra.//: The kernel is NOT required here, deliberately. This package is a path repo INSIDE the kernel and is required BY it; requiring it back would be a cycle composer resolves only by luck. Everything the harness touches (Kernel, Ports, HttpPipeline) is present because the kernel is what loads it.
